changelog:
* Added support for `AccountDelete` transaction in Ripple.
* Added support for Solana off-chain message signing (OCMS) v0.
* Added MCU device attestation with ML-DSA-44.
* Added Tap to Wake setting in device menu.
* Solana System Program Transfer instruction now supports multisig.
* Improved Tron TRX transfer flow.
* Improved Stellar confirmation flows.
